metadata.description: Deploys the Financial MCP Server to Azure Container Apps using the prebuilt public image from GHCR. Exposes the MCP endpoint over HTTPS at /mcp.
Name of the Container App (also used to name the environment and logs workspace).
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group's region.
Container image to deploy. Defaults to the public GHCR image published by CI.
Required bearer token for streamable-http access.
Optional. SerpAPI key for news/market data tools.
Optional. Telegram bot token for alerts.
Optional. Telegram chat/user id for alerts.
Optional. Reachable Ollama URL for the news summarizer (e.g. https://my-ollama:11434).

configuration.secrets: [concat(if(empty(parameters('mcpAccessToken')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'mcp-access-token', 'value', parameters('mcpAccessToken')))), if(empty(parameters('serpApiKey')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'serpapi-key', 'value', parameters('serpApiKey')))), if(empty(parameters('telegramBotToken')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'telegram-bot-token', 'value', parameters('telegramBotToken')))))]

containers.name: financial-mcp-server
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'MCP_TRANSPORT', 'value', 'streamable-http'), createObject('name', 'HOST', 'value', '0.0.0.0'), createObject('name', 'PORT', 'value', '8000'), createObject('name', 'LOG_LEVEL', 'value', parameters('logLevel'))), if(empty(parameters('mcpAccessToken')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN', 'secretRef', 'mcp-access-token'))), if(empty(parameters('serpApiKey')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'SERPAPI_API_KEY', 'secretRef', 'serpapi-key'))), if(empty(parameters('telegramBotToken')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN', 'secretRef', 'telegram-bot-token'))), if(empty(parameters('telegramUserId')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'TELEGRAM_USER_ID', 'value', parameters('telegramUserId')))), if(empty(parameters('ollamaHost')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'OLLAMA_HOST', 'value', parameters('ollamaHost')))))]
